# ECN-2026-023 Change notice - Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P2, line P2-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-RR01

Reason for change
- Background: During routine maintenance and reliability reviews of Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01), lubrication performance deviations were observed in the main radial bearing lubrication system. Condition monitoring records indicated increased vibration and bearing temperature trends that were traced to inconsistent lubricant supply and a change in vendor performance of the legacy lubricant. An engineering evaluation recommended a controlled change to the approved lubricant to address contamination control, film stability, and compatibility with existing seals and metering devices.
- Objective: Standardize the lubricant in the primary radial bearing circuit to an approved Cascade Forge Works lubricant identified by part number CFW-LUB-724 in order to restore consistent lubrication performance, reduce unplanned stoppages, and simplify inventory and procurement for P2, line P2-L1.
- Rationale: CFW-LUB-724 was selected after laboratory compatibility testing with machine elastomers and materials, bench tribology testing representative of the ring rolling mill service, and supplier quality assurance review. The lubricant meets internal acceptance criteria documented in SB-1030 and is compatible with the machine's existing filtration and metering hardware described in SOP-P2-L1-01 and SOP-P2-L1-02. Adopting a single, specified lubricant reduces cross-contamination risk and streamlines parts and materials traceability.

Affected items
- Equipment effected: Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1, asset tag EQ-P2-L1-RR01, including main radial bearing lubrication circuits, refill reservoirs, and associated supply lines identified in the equipment lubrication schematic.
- Procedures: Lubrication procedures and reservoir refill steps in SOP-P2-L1-01 and the inspection and sampling steps in SOP-P2-L1-02 require update to reference CFW-LUB-724 as the approved lubricant for EQ-P2-L1-RR01.
- Inventory: Plant storeroom inventory for P2, line P2-L1 must be updated to include CFW-LUB-724 as the designated stock item for radial bearing lubrication for EQ-P2-L1-RR01. Existing stocks of other lubricants previously used on EQ-P2-L1-RR01 must be quarantined and dispositioned per SB-1030.
- Training and competence: Maintenance personnel performing lubrication tasks on EQ-P2-L1-RR01 are affected; training records must reflect the change and updated procedural steps.

Implementation
- Approval boundary: This change is limited to Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) at Plant P2, line P2-L1. No other equipment is affected unless explicitly listed in a separate ECN.
- Procurement and supply: All future purchases for radial bearing lubricant for EQ-P2-L1-RR01 must use the part number CFW-LUB-724. Procurement will only accept material tagged with this part number for the affected asset. Incoming material shall be checked against the supplier certificate of analysis and lot identification per SB-1030.
- Preparation: Prior to first fill with CFW-LUB-724, the lubrication reservoir and supply lines shall be drained and flushed to remove residual lubricant from prior fills. Flushing agents and methods shall follow the guidance in SOP-P2-L1-01 to ensure material compatibility with CFW-LUB-724 and system elastomers. Flush waste and cleaning records must be retained with the work order.
- First-fill execution: Maintenance shall perform the first-fill sequence under a planned maintenance work order. The work order shall reference ECN-2026-023 and include the following required records: batch/lot number of CFW-LUB-724 used, supplier certificate of analysis, pre- and post-fill condition readings, and a signed verification by the maintenance supervisor that flushing and fill steps conformed to SOP-P2-L1-01.
- Post-change monitoring: After implementation, the reliability team will monitor EQ-P2-L1-RR01 using existing condition monitoring processes documented in SOP-P2-L1-02. Trending records, bearing vibration readings, and any abnormal alarms shall be reviewed and retained in the maintenance record for the asset. Any deviation from expected performance shall trigger immediate inspection and corrective action, with records updated under the associated work order.
- Examples of acceptable records: a completed work order packet containing the CFW-LUB-724 lot number, supplier certificate of analysis, signed procedural checklists referencing SOP-P2-L1-01, and post-fill condition monitoring logs pulled per SOP-P2-L1-02.
- Change to documentation: SOP-P2-L1-01 and SOP-P2-L1-02 shall be revised to list CFW-LUB-724 as the approved lubricant for EQ-P2-L1-RR01. The revisions shall be controlled updates coordinated through document control and linked to this ECN. Operators and maintenance staff will receive the updated procedures and a briefing prior to first-fill.
- Inventory disposition: Existing lubricant stocks previously assigned to EQ-P2-L1-RR01 must be quarantined, labeled, and processed following SB-1030 for disposition. Records of disposition shall be attached to the ECN closeout package.

Approvals
- Engineering approval: The responsible mechanical engineering reviewer must sign to confirm laboratory compatibility testing and bench testing support the use of CFW-LUB-724 for EQ-P2-L1-RR01. The approval shall reference SB-1030 evidence and link to updated SOP-P2-L1-01 and SOP-P2-L1-02.
- Maintenance approval: Maintenance management must sign to authorize implementation of the drain, flush, and first-fill activities and to confirm training and resources are scheduled. Maintenance must ensure that work orders capture required records and that the maintenance planner updates inventory masters to include CFW-LUB-724 for the asset.
- Quality assurance approval: QA shall confirm receipt and review of supplier certification for CFW-LUB-724 batches used on the asset and approve final release of the ECN upon satisfactory completion of first-fill and initial monitoring.
- Records to keep: Attach to the ECN closeout package the following items: supplier certificate of analysis for each CFW-LUB-724 lot used, completed work order with signed checklists, pre/post condition monitoring logs produced per SOP-P2-L1-02, inventory change notifications, and revised procedure documents SOP-P2-L1-01 and SOP-P2-L1-02 with change markings.
- Closure criteria: ECN will be closed after engineering, maintenance, and QA approvals are documented and post-change monitoring demonstrates restored and stable lubrication performance for EQ-P2-L1-RR01 per the acceptance process in SB-1030. The closeout package must be submitted to document control and filed against the asset record.

Related documents
- SB-1030
- SOP-P2-L1-01
- SOP-P2-L1-02

Approved by:
- Engineering (name/signature)
- Maintenance (name/signature)
- Quality Assurance (name/signature)

Note: The specified lubricant part number for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 is CFW-LUB-724 and must be used in all implementation and procurement actions for EQ-P2-L1-RR01.
